description:
Datapath Software Engineer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Datapath Software Engineer for a contract opportunity in Santa Clara, California. 
 

 Datapath Software Engineer Job Details 
 

 The following skills will be utilized: Fluent with C/C++ programming and networking,
 Networking: IP protocols (TCP, UDP), understanding of networks and packet routing, 
 and fully capable to work with Linux OS including installing and configuring different flavors, packages and drivers installation and configuration and other Linux administration 
 

 Datapath Software Engineer Mandatory Skills 
 

 BSc or MSc in Computer Science or related field
 Fluent with C/C++ programming and networking
 Networking: IP protocols (TCP, UDP), understanding of networks and packet routing
 Fully capable to work with Linux OS including installing and configuring different flavors, packages and drivers installation and configuration and other Linux administration
 Optional (plus) in descending order of priorities:
 

 Programing experience for Virtual Data Center environments: VMWare/NSX, OpenStack
 Knowledge and understanding (contributor) of Open Stack networking (Neutron) plugins development
  
 Knowledge of Intel DPDK or any other Data packets I/O SDKs
 Experience/Knowledge in Python programming language is a plus
 Experience/Knowledge with Network Security is a Plus
 Familiarity with IDS/IPS and/or Firewall software is a plus
 

 Datapath Software Engineer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 Datapath Software Engineer Assignment Length 
 

 13+ Months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
